title: Reasons & Purposes: ゆえに, とあって, こととて, ばこそ, んがため, べく, とあれば
description: Formal 'because' (with its nuances: special occasion, apology, the very reason), formal 'in order to', and 'if it's for …'.

points.title: 〜ゆえ(に) / ゆえの: because of (formal)
points.summary: Noun / plain form + ゆえ(に) = because of; ゆえの + noun = … caused by.
points.body:
- 貧しさ**ゆえに**、学校に行けなかった.
- 若さ**ゆえの**過ち.
examples: {若|わか}さゆえの{過|あやま}ちだった。
It was a mistake of youth.

points.title: 〜とあって: since (it's a special situation)
points.summary: Plain form / noun + とあって = because of this (unusual) circumstance, what we see is …. Describes others / the scene.
points.body: - 連休**とあって**、行楽地はどこも混雑している.
examples: {人気|にんき}{歌手|かしゅ}が{来|く}るとあって、{会場|かいじょう}は{満員|まんいん}だった。
With a popular singer coming, the venue was packed.

points.title: 〜こととて: because (apologising)
points.summary: Plain form + こととて = since it was … (so please excuse it). Formal, old-fashioned.
points.body: - 慣れぬ**こととて**、ご迷惑をおかけしました.
examples: {子供|こども}のしたこととて、お{許|ゆる}しください。
It was done by a child — please forgive it.

points.title: 〜ばこそ: precisely because
points.summary: ば-form + こそ = it's exactly because A (often a good motive behind something unwelcome).
points.body: - 君のことを思え**ばこそ**、厳しく言うのだ.
examples: {健康|けんこう}であればこそ、{仕事|しごと}もできる。
It's precisely because you're healthy that you can work.

points.title: 〜んがため(に): in order to (at all costs)
points.summary: ない-stem + んがため (する → せんがため) = with the strong aim of.
points.body: - 勝た**んがため**、彼は毎日練習した.
examples: {生|い}きんがために{働|はたら}く。
One works in order to live.

points.title: 〜べく: in order to (formal)
points.summary: Dictionary form + べく (する → すべく) = with the intention of.
points.body:
- 留学す**べく**、貯金を始めた.
- Don't confuse with べき (should) / べからず (must not).
examples: {問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}すべく、{会議|かいぎ}が{開|ひら}かれた。
A meeting was held to solve the problem.

points.title: 〜とあれば: if it's (for) …
points.summary: Noun / plain form + とあれば = if that's the case / if it's for that, (I'll do anything).
points.body: - 子供のため**とあれば**、どんな苦労もいとわない.
examples: {社長|しゃちょう}の{命令|めいれい}とあれば、{従|したが}うしかない。
If it's the president's order, I have no choice but to obey.

questions.prompt: {貧|まず}しさ（　）、{彼|かれ}は{学校|がっこう}に{行|い}けなかった。
notes: ゆえの needs a noun after it.
とあって describes a special occasion and the scene it causes.
ばこそ follows a ば-form.
questions.translation: Because of poverty, he couldn't go to school.

questions.prompt: あれは{若|わか}さ（　）{過|あやま}ちだった。
notes: 若さばかりの isn't natural.
ゆえに can't modify a noun.
若さながらの isn't a phrase.
questions.translation: That was a mistake born of youth.

questions.prompt: {連休|れんきゅう}（　）、{行楽地|こうらくち}はどこも{混雑|こんざつ}している。
notes: とあれば = 'if it's for' — the holiday is a fact, not a condition.
とはいえ = 'although' — crowds are the expected result.
questions.translation: With the long weekend, every holiday spot is packed.

questions.prompt: What does 「{人気|にんき}{歌手|かしゅ}が{来|く}るとあって、{会場|かいじょう}は{満員|まんいん}だった。」 mean?
options: With a popular singer coming, the venue was packed.
If a popular singer comes, the venue will be full.
Although a popular singer came, the venue was full.
The venue was full, so the singer came.
questions.explanation: とあって = **because of this special situation**.
notes: とあって is a fact, not a condition.

questions.prompt: {慣|な}れぬ（　）、ご{迷惑|めいわく}をおかけしました。
questions.translation: Being new to this, I'm afraid I caused you trouble.

questions.prompt: What does 「{子供|こども}のしたこととて、お{許|ゆる}しください。」 mean?
options: It was done by a child — please forgive it.
Please forgive the child for what it will do.

questions.prompt: {君|きみ}のことを{思|おも}え（　）、{厳|きび}しく{言|い}うのだ。
notes: ばそれまで = 'if …, that's the end'.
思えばいい = 'you just have to think'.
questions.translation: It's precisely because I care about you that I'm being strict.

questions.prompt: What does 「{健康|けんこう}であればこそ、{仕事|しごと}もできる。」 mean?
options: It's precisely because you're healthy that you can work.
If you're healthy, you don't need to work.
Even if you're healthy, you can't work.

questions.prompt: {勝|か}た（　）、{彼|かれ}は{毎日|まいにち}{厳|きび}しい{練習|れんしゅう}を{続|つづ}けた。
notes: んばかりに = 'as if about to'.
ずにはおかない ends a sentence.
ずじまい = 'ended up not doing'.
questions.translation: Determined to win, he kept up hard training every day.

questions.prompt: What does 「{生|い}きんがために{働|はたら}く。」 mean?
options: One lives in order to work.
One works in order to live.
questions.explanation: んがため = **for the sake of**.
notes: んがため marks the goal (living).

questions.prompt: {留学|りゅうがく}す（　）、{貯金|ちょきん}を{始|はじ}めた。
notes: べき = 'should' — must modify a noun or end the sentence.
questions.translation: I started saving so that I could study abroad.

questions.prompt: {問題|もんだい}を{解決|かいけつ}す（　）、{緊急|きんきゅう}{会議|かいぎ}が{開|ひら}かれた。
questions.translation: An emergency meeting was held to solve the problem.

questions.prompt: {子供|こども}のため（　）、どんな{苦労|くろう}もいとわない。
notes: とあって = 'because (special occasion)' — this is a condition.
questions.translation: If it's for my children, I'll put up with any hardship.

questions.prompt: What does 「{社長|しゃちょう}の{命令|めいれい}とあれば、{従|したが}うしかない。」 mean?
options: Even the president's orders can be ignored.
Because the president ordered it, I disobeyed.
If it's the president's order, I have no choice but to obey.
